name: @emit-ia/n8n-template-mcp

tools.name: n8n_search_templates
tools.description:
[API] Search n8n workflow templates from the community API (returns up to 10 optimized results)

⚡️ Best for:
  ✓ Finding templates for specific automation tasks
  ✓ Discovering workflow examples for node types
  ✓ Browsing templates by category or tags
  ✓ Getting template inspiration for projects

⚠️ Not for:
  × Getting detailed template implementation
  × Downloading workflow files directly
  × Creating new templates

→ Next steps: n8n_get_template, n8n_export_templates

→ Related: n8n_list_categories, n8n_find_by_node

tools.name: n8n_get_template
tools.description:
[API] Get detailed information about a specific n8n template including full workflow JSON

⚡️ Best for:
  ✓ Getting complete template implementation details
  ✓ Reviewing template workflow structure
  ✓ Understanding node configurations
  ✓ Preparing for template import to n8n

⚠️ Not for:
  × Searching multiple templates
  × Getting template lists
  × Modifying templates

→ Prerequisites: n8n_search_templates

→ Next steps: n8n_export_templates

→ Related: n8n_find_by_node

tools.name: n8n_list_categories
tools.description:
[API] Get all available template categories and subcategories from n8n community

⚡️ Best for:
  ✓ Browsing available template categories
  ✓ Understanding template organization
  ✓ Planning targeted template searches
  ✓ Getting category-based template counts

⚠️ Not for:
  × Searching specific templates
  × Getting template details
  × Creating categories

→ Next steps: n8n_search_templates

→ Related: n8n_find_by_node

tools.name: n8n_find_by_node
tools.description:
[API] Find n8n templates that use a specific node type (returns up to 8 optimized results)

⚡️ Best for:
  ✓ Finding examples for specific node types
  ✓ Learning node configuration patterns
  ✓ Discovering integration templates
  ✓ Understanding node usage in workflows

⚠️ Not for:
  × General template searching
  × Getting node documentation
  × Creating new node types

→ Next steps: n8n_get_template, n8n_export_templates

→ Related: n8n_search_templates, n8n_list_categories

tools.name: n8n_export_templates
tools.description:
[WORKFLOW] Export multiple n8n templates as workflow JSON files ready for import into n8n

⚡️ Best for:
  ✓ Preparing templates for n8n import
  ✓ Bulk downloading workflow definitions
  ✓ Creating workflow collections
  ✓ Backing up template workflows

⚠️ Not for:
  × Searching templates
  × Getting single template details
  × Modifying template content

→ Prerequisites: n8n_search_templates, n8n_get_template

→ Related: n8n_find_by_node

tools.name: n8n_health_check
tools.description:
[UTILITY] Check the health and availability of the n8n community API

⚡️ Best for:
  ✓ Verifying API connectivity
  ✓ Troubleshooting connection issues
  ✓ Monitoring service availability
  ✓ Pre-flight checks before operations

⚠️ Not for:
  × Getting template data
  × Performing searches
  × Exporting workflows

→ Next steps: n8n_search_templates, n8n_list_categories

tools.name: n8n_clear_cache
tools.description:
[UTILITY] Clear the template cache to force fresh data retrieval from n8n API

⚡️ Best for:
  ✓ Refreshing stale template data
  ✓ Troubleshooting cache issues
  ✓ Freeing memory usage
  ✓ Getting latest template updates

⚠️ Not for:
  × Regular template operations
  × Performance optimization
  × Data backup

→ Next steps: n8n_search_templates, n8n_health_check
